title: FastH3 post-DiT optimization evidence
boundary: DiT output latents through full audiovisual MP4 response; not Twitch delivery latency

exact_ops.limitation: single GPU, one temporal window; no PP8 or full-video E2E

probe.scope: Real H3 first-block weights at B1/B3/B4 geometry; includes quantization cost.

scheduling.scope: VAE-only synthetic latent, original FP32 pixel equality, rank-zero diagnostic trace; separate from full video E2E

historical_trace.scope: Historical single profiled Config A request; not current unprofiled latency or an optimization A/B.

aac_overlap.scope: One warmed profiled request, not latency measurement

limitations: Fixed seeds and limited prompts; no universal quality or latency guarantee.
Kernel durations, CPU scope durations, and overlapped pipeline spans cannot be added.
Historical 15-second campaigns differ from the current five-second workload.
CPU candidate changes are not active in the published five-second runtime.
No new GPU experiments were run for this report.
